title: Clicker
note: Hand-written card, not generated. Clicker is a solo game whose layout comes from ctx.rng, so the cell numbers below are only true for seed 12345 — which is why the seed is pinned here. A scenario file does not have to come from scripts/new-game.mjs; it only has to be a spec a stranger can check.
maxLinesNote: Higher than a builder card. The 250 cap is there to stop a small model writing an essay; Clicker is hand-written and heavily commented, in the house style. It also carries three modes (Game, Instrument, Sequencer) in one file, so it is genuinely long.
rules: A 9x9 grid with a 16-second clock per level. Level 1 lights one button. Every level adds one more button in a random free cell. You only ever click the red button; the yellow button shows which cell will turn red next, and the rest are blue. Clear the whole queue before time runs out to score a point.
cellNote: cell = col + row * 9 on the 9x9 board. These numbers depend on the seed AND on the gate giving each reduce() a fresh ctx.rng — which is what makes a replay reproducible. Change the seed and they all change. At seed 12345 the levels run 39, then 50+11, then 28+11+35, then 28+32+37+41.
rulesNote: A click that is not the button you owe is refused, not ignored: reduce() answers { error }. The board still plays its own wrong-click sound locally, so the player sees nothing but a thud.

scenarios.name: one click scores a point and the grid grows by one
clicking a blue cell is refused
a cell off the board is refused
three levels in a row, then the run is reported

expect.summarize: Alice scored 3 points in Clicker, reaching level 4
